mapper.select: SELECT * FROM automation_rules ORDER BY enabled DESC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO automation_rules (name, condition_type, condition_value, condition_detail, target_project_id, target_category, action_type, action_value, action_detail, enabled) VALUES (#{name},#{conditionType},#{conditionValue},#{conditionDetail},#{targetProjectId},#{targetCategory},#{actionType},#{actionValue},#{actionDetail},COALESCE(#{enabled},FALSE))
mapper.update: UPDATE automation_rules SET name=#{name}, condition_type=#{conditionType}, condition_value=#{conditionValue}, condition_detail=#{conditionDetail}, target_project_id=#{targetProjectId}, target_category=#{targetCategory}, action_type=#{actionType}, action_value=#{actionValue}, action_detail=#{actionDetail}, enabled=#{enabled} WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE automation_rules SET enabled=#{enabled} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id,rule_id,todo_id,run_key,status,message,executed_at FROM automation_rule_runs WHERE rule_id=#{ruleId} ORDER BY executed_at DESC LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE automation_rules SET last_executed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, execution_count=execution_count+1 WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id,title,detail,category,priority,due_date,scheduled_date,planned_start_time,planned_end_time,planned_minutes,actual_seconds,timer_started_at,timer_status,schedule_change_count,project_id,section_id,completed,completed_at,deleted_at,pinned,created_at,updated_at FROM todos WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE todos SET priority=#{priority} WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE todos SET category=#{category} WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE todos SET project_id=#{projectId} WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM todos WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND completed=FALSE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM todos WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND completed=TRUE AND completed_at >= CURRENT_DATE()
SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(actual_seconds)/60),0) FROM todos WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND updated_at >= CURRENT_DATE()
